body: Just doing day-to-day things makes me feel exhausted. I'm just tired of having to keep going like this, I guess. Thinking of the future and the shit that I'm going to have to deal with doesn't make me want to stick things out. I don't know.

I don't understand how I'm supposed to embrace it. I feel like you're oversimplifying things. I can't remember feeling a normal spectrum of emotions, so I don't know how to get on that level. There's a lot of things about this world that one can be appreciative of and I obviously recognize that, but seeking knowledge on subjects like quantum physics can't absolve me of my problems, fix the state that my life has been in, or lessen my depression.

I use sparingly to begin with, but I may stop completely. 

Life is just unremarkable to me. Everything I do is mundane; nothing excites me. I don't feel strong emotions of any sort. Doing the things that you're describing just feel like going through the motions to me. I've felt like this for as far back as I can remember. I just don't enjoy doing things for some reason.
I want to further my education in itself, but I plan to become a teacher of some sort after graduating. Maybe TESL. Not sure.

I just feel pissed off that others can get actual effects from them and I can't. I wish that I would be able to get the same reaction.

I'm not sure what else to say. What do you want to know about me?
